newsitem.title: USA: MICROS Systems reaches legal settlement.
newsitem.headline: MICROS Systems reaches legal settlement.

text.p: MICROS Systems Inc said Monday it and a unit had reached a legal settlement resolving all outstanding litigation with Vagabond Inns/Imperial Hotels Corp.

Under the terms of the agreeement, MICROS said it and its wholly-owned subsidiary Fidelio Software GmbH would provide software upgrades to the central reservation system software that Vagabond Inns had licensed.
In June, Imperial began a litigation against MICROS alleging fraud and breach of contract in connection with the sale of property management and central reservation system software.
It sought damages in excess of $1 million plus punitive damages.
